fine_lines.title: going to vs present continuous for plans
fine_lines.explanation_ar: كلاهما للخطط المستقبلية. be going to + الفعل لخطة قررناها (I'm going to visit my grandparents). والمضارع المستمر لترتيب محدد بوقت (We're leaving in the afternoon).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both talk about future plans. going to + verb = a decided plan. Present continuous = a fixed arrangement.

examples.sentence: I'm going to visit my grandparents.

fine_lines.title: bring vs take
fine_lines.explanation_ar: bring تعني تُحضر شيئًا إلى المكان الذي يوجد فيه المتكلم أو المكان المقصود معك. take تعني تأخذ شيئًا بعيدًا عن هنا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Bring = carry something to here/with you to a place. Take = carry something away from here.

examples.sentence: We're bringing sandwiches to the picnic.
Take your coat when you go out.

expressions.phrase: Do you have any plans for this weekend?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل لديك أي خطط لعطلة نهاية الأسبوع؟
expressions.example: Do you have any plans for this weekend? Yes, I'm visiting my aunt.

expressions.phrase: I'm going to visit my grandparents.
expressions.example: On Friday, I'm going to visit my grandparents.
I'm going to the beach. That sounds nice!

expressions.meaning_en: Ask about the place of a plan.
expressions.example: Where are you going? To the mountains.

expressions.phrase: How long are you planning to hike?
expressions.meaning_en: Ask about the length of an activity.
expressions.example: How long are you planning to stay? Two days.

expressions.phrase: What are you bringing for the picnic?
expressions.example: What are you bringing for the picnic? Fruit and juice.
What time are you leaving? At three.

expressions.phrase: I hope you have a great time!
expressions.example: Enjoy your trip. I hope you have a great time!

grammar.title: be going to + verb for plans
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم am/is/are + going to + الفعل في أصله للحديث عن خطة قررناها: I'm going to visit my grandparents. We're going to cook together.
grammar.explanation_en: Use am/is/are + going to + base verb for plans.
examples: I'm going to visit my grandparents.
What are you going to do?

grammar.title: Present continuous for future arrangements
grammar.explanation_ar: يمكن استخدام المضارع المستمر للحديث عن ترتيب مستقبلي محدد: I'm going hiking. We're leaving in the afternoon. What are you bringing?
grammar.explanation_en: The present continuous can talk about fixed future plans.
examples: I am going hiking with some friends.
We're bringing sandwiches, fruit, and some drinks.
We are leaving in the afternoon.

grammar.title: will for the future
grammar.explanation_ar: will + الفعل في أصله للمستقبل: We'll have a picnic. What will you do?
grammar.explanation_en: will + base verb for the future.
examples: What will you do with your grandparents?
